source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Starting with the Defender, players take turns setting up units singly, each wholly within their own deployment zone; units in **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** are left out. Then:

- After setting up a **TITANIC** unit, skip your next placement.
- Once one player has set up all their units, the other sets up all their remaining units.

detail.finish: the other side sets up all units still due to deploy
